playerPuzzle: Solve the puzzle on the board
setupHint: Pick a piece and tap a square, or drag it onto the board. Tap again to remove it.
err_kings: The board needs exactly one king of each colour.
err_pawns: Pawns can't stand on the first or last rank.
err_check: The side not to move is in check — that position can't happen.
positionResetWarn: Changing the position will erase the recorded moves.
fixPositionFirst: Fix the position on the Position tab first.
solutionHint: Play moves for both sides on the board: first the student's move, then the opponent's reply, and so on. The last move should be the student's.
solutionEndsWithReply: The solution ends with an opponent reply — it won't be played.
promptPlaceholder: E.g. White to play and mate in 2
studyHint: Play moves on the board — you can add a comment to each one.
puzzleSolvedMistakes: Solved, but with a mistake — no point awarded.
